title: Innovative 2D dioxonium vanadium oxide: enhancing stability in aqueous zinc-ion battery cathodes
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,39193-39203
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA06871H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Yannis De Luna, Zakiah Mohamed, Abdulilah Dawoud, Nasr Bensalah
Layered V3O8(H3O)2 was applied as Zn-ion batteries cathode, delivering a highly stable performance. DFT calculations showed a structural change during cycling, resulting in significant specific capacity enhancement and stabilization.
